packageRules.description: STAB-15 — patch-only auto-merge, and only meaningful because batch 0 made CI run the tests. Renovate merges when the required checks pass; before batch 0 those checks were lint, type-check and build with no test step at all, so this rule would have been merging untested code. Ordering is the safety property here, not the rule.
Group the Supabase SDK — @supabase/supabase-js and @supabase/ssr move in lockstep and a split upgrade produces a cookie/session mismatch. Never auto-merged: this is the authentication path.

Group the test harness — runner, TypeScript transformer, jsdom environment, type definitions and the three testing-library packages. They are version-coupled, and a human reads the result because a broken harness is how a green CI stops meaning anything.

Group Next with its ESLint config — eslint-config-next tracks the framework version. NEVER auto-merge the framework: batch 2 of this phase needed a smoke pass and a migration note for a single patch-level bump of it.
Majors are never auto-merged. STAB-10 requires a major to arrive as an isolated change carrying a migration note, and a bot cannot write one.

PROJECT.md defers React 19 — do not open the PR at all. This is `enabled: false`, not `automerge: false`, deliberately: a bot that keeps reopening a PR the project has already decided against is noise that trains people to close bot PRs unread, which is how a real security PR gets closed unread too.
